title: The Shares of the Vacation Packages Desk's Own Cancellation Schedule
content:
The vacation packages desk keeps its own cancellation schedule for Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products, keyed by the whole days lying between the day the party confirmed the cancellation and the departure date recorded on the package.

| Days between the day the party confirmed the cancellation and the departure date | The cancellation share taken on the penalised value |
| --- | --- |
| 14 or fewer | the near-departure share, 90 per cent |
| between 15 and 42 | the inside-six-weeks share, 55 per cent |
| between 43 and 89 | the inside-three-months share, 30 per cent |
| 90 or more | not varied by this schedule |

## The clauses the table puts

Where 14 days or fewer lie between the day the party confirmed the cancellation and the departure date, the cancellation share is the near-departure share of the desk's cancellation schedule, being 90 per cent. Where between 15 and 42 days lie between them, the cancellation share is the inside-six-weeks share, being 55 per cent. Where between 43 and 89 days lie between them, the cancellation share is the inside-three-months share, being 30 per cent. Where 90 or more days lie between them, the cancellation share is not varied by this schedule.

## Both sides of every boundary

The bands meet without a gap and without an overlap. A cancellation confirmed 14 days before departure falls in the first band at 90 per cent, and one confirmed 15 days before departure falls in the second at 55 per cent. A cancellation confirmed 42 days before departure is in the second band at 55 per cent, and one confirmed 43 days before departure is in the third at 30 per cent. A cancellation confirmed 89 days before departure is in the third band, and one confirmed 90 days before departure is outside the schedule's bands altogether.

The day counted is the day the party confirmed the cancellation, as the package record carries it, and not the day the desk takes the file up.
